description: Intent i024 (SNAPSHOT=s03, branch=callee-pull-caller-stale) concluded with a bounded evidence-backed negative. The s03 snapshot's head-relocating call surface was enumerated (371 files in net/ and drivers/net/ containing pskb_may_pull/__pskb_pull_tail/pskb_pull/skb_linearize/skb_cow*/pskb_expand_head), and the canonical thin-wrapper callee family was audited at the interprocedural boundary: ip_mc_may_pull() at include/linux/igmp.h:256-262 is a wrapper over pskb_may_pull(skb, len) (may __pskb_pull_tail -> pskb_expand_head and free skb->head). Its caller br_ip4_multicast_igmp3_report() at net/bridge/br_multicast.c:2845-2953, which parses fully attacker-controlled IGMPv3 reports from bridge ports, calls the wrapper twice per loop iteration (lines 2866 and 2875) while ih (captured 2860) and grec (captured 2869) are in scope, but no stale dereference exists: ih is last read at 2861 before pull #1; group/type/nsrcs are copied to stack scalars at 2870-2872 before pull #2; and after pull #2 the code explicitly reloads grec from the current skb->data ('/* reload grec and host addr */' comment, grec = (void *)(skb->data + len - sizeof(*grec) - (nsrcs * 4)) at 2921) and takes h_addr = &ip_hdr(skb)->saddr at 2922, so all post-pull grec->grec_src uses (2926-2952, feeding br_multicast_isinc_allow/isexc/toin/toex/block state transitions) go through the reloaded pointer. s03 carries the fixed variant of the parser reported buggy in sibling snapshots s02/s05 (facts f009/f012) — classified safe. No credible interprocedural stale-pointer finding remains. Limitations recorded in the artifact: the callee->caller enumeration was halted at the finalize instruction — callers of validator callees ip_mc_check_igmp (br_multicast.c:3882) and ipv6_mc_check_mld (br_multicast.c:3951) remain unresolved, as do the other 370 files' wrapper-callee callers; drivers/ outside drivers/net, arch/, fs/ were not audited; the tail of br_ip4_multicast_igmp3_report() beyond line 2953 was not read; and same-function sites belong to the concluded tx-cow/loop-parser/GRO artifacts (f002/f011/f017) and the still-open rx-pull intent i009. Final artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C6/agent-state/findings/i024.json (version 1, execution_status complete, snapshots_checked ["s03"], findings [], candidates 1 safe + 1 unresolved, limitations 6).
